about: Sentry instances, non-secret: host, keychain (the token's Keychain or secret-tool service, account sentry; without either, the variable SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN_<NAME>), and optional server, orgs and note. The instance whose server is `sentry` is the catalog's sentry entry in servers.json; every other one renders a clone of it named `server` (default sentry-<name>), only once it has a token. `orgs` labels orgs whose slug does not say prd/prod or stg/staging. A preset's [sentry.instances] land here at setup; <overlay>/sentry-instances.json overrides field by field or adds instances. bin/sentry-map discovers each instance's orgs and projects.
